notes: All MASE/WAPE values were re-derived with the locked harness (stage0/eval/harness.py, metrics_from_frame, MASE denominator = train-only in-seasonal-naive MAE at lag 12) from the raw point-forecast CSVs named in each source_file; 1,104 points = 12 origins x 4 horizons x 23 series.
Values are rounded to at most 4 decimals as required by the deliverable spec; full precision (MASE 5dp) is recoverable from the source_file.
Top-level 2024 retail total = sum of the 8 top-level series [2,8,9,12,18,30,32,35] only, because the other 15 series are children of 4 parents and summing all 23 would double-count.

DISCREPANCY: stage0/results/stage0_results.csv reports xLSTM MASE_ALL = 0.93828; that is the leaky-validation seed-42 single run (see stage0/results/stage0_purged_val.csv row xLSTM_leaky_s42). The purged 3-seed mean is 0.98355 and the 3-seed ensemble is 0.94810. All three appear in the leaderboard under distinct model labels.

DISCREPANCY: LightGBMTuned_residual is 1.04108 in stage0/results/stage0_baselines_extra.csv but 1.03016 in stage0/results/extra_preds_metrics.csv. The 1.04108 figure is the arithmetic mean of the three per-seed MASE_ALL values (0.88376/0.89568... i.e. per-seed 1.03016, 1.05438, 1.03871), matching the report headline; 1.03016 is the score of the single default file extra_preds_LightGBMTuned_residual.csv. Its WAPE likewise differs: 0.10412 (seed-mean) vs 0.10333 (single file). FINAL_REPORT.md table ES-1 pairs the seed-mean MASE with the single-file WAPE (10.333%).

DISCREPANCY: FINAL_REPORT.md table ES-1 lists Drift as 1.46610 while recomputation from stage0/results/predictions.csv gives 1.46612 (0.00002 rounding difference noted in docs/VERIFIED_ANCHORS.md). Ridge_residual likewise 1.17130 in prose vs 1.17127 computed.

DLinear/NLinear exist in TWO independent implementations: 'extra-impl' (stage0/results/extra_preds_metrics.csv, e.g. DLinear_residual 1.34248) and the SOTA-baseline implementation reusing the xLSTM training loop (stage0/results/SOTA_BASELINES.md, e.g. DLinear shared ENS3 1.03194). Both are listed as separate model labels; do not compare across implementations.

TFT and TimesNet DO NOT EXIST in this repository. Exhaustive check: stage0/results/sota_preds/ contains only {itransformer, timetf, dlinear, nlinear, xlstm_persist} stems; the 'timetf' prefix is the internal filename for TimeTokenCI (a channel-INDEPENDENT twin of iTransformer with time tokens, see docs/VERIFIED_ANCHORS.md sec 3 and SOTA_BASELINES.md), NOT a Temporal Fusion Transformer. FINAL_REPORT.md table 3-4 also has no TFT/TimesNet row.

parent_levels = 8 counts series with level==0 in stage0/data/panel_meta.json. Of those 8, only 4 are parents that have children (2, 12, 18, 35) and 4 are standalone (8, 9, 30, 32); there are 15 level-1 children. So 8 = 4 parents + 4 standalone. Prose elsewhere conflicts: stage2_stage4/RESULTS.md says '4 parents + 19 leaves' and FINAL_REPORT.md says '4 parent industries + 15 child industries + 4 standalone = 23'. The 4+15+4 decomposition agrees with panel_meta.json; the '4+19' phrasing does not.

Ablation steps 'Direct level prediction' (2.0963) and 'Fixed residual anchor' (1.0119) survive only as prose in 01_ARCHITECTURE.md lines 838-839, transcribed from a training log; no CSV or log file in the repo contains those two numbers. Every other ladder rung has a machine-readable source.

DISCREPANCY: stage2_stage4/RESULTS.md sec 2.3 table row labelled ridge_residual (MASE_ALL 4.49702) is actually the --demean run: its per-horizon values reproduce the mean of stage0/results/stage2_metrics_all_demean.csv exactly. The non-demean file stage0/results/stage2_metrics_all.csv gives a 3-seed mean of 4.90139. Both are listed under distinct labels.

qa.prefix_mask_max_abs_diff = 0.0 is the Q2 prefix-mask causality test (stage3/data/verify_causality.csv, 7 features x 231 in-window months, all bit-identical). The separate Q1 formula check (stage3/data/verify_formula.csv) has max abs diff 4.440892098500626e-16 over 3 features; both are recorded so the two are not confused.

qa.noise_control_delta_mase = 0.14044 is text_scalar (3 text features, 3-seed mean MASE_ALL 1.19524) minus random3 (3 random-noise features of identical width, 1.05480): the real text features LOSE to equal-width noise by this margin. Eventual conclusion recorded in stage3/RESULTS.md sec 5.3.

Stage-2 ridge and Stage-4 reconciliation figures are 3-seed means of per-seed metrics, not ensembles; Stage-4 base constraint violation is mean|A*yhat| = 161.63 HK$m (mean of stage0/results/stage4_gaps.csv base rows 162.6157/141.9713/180.3078) collapsing to ~1e-13 after any reconciliation.
stage0/data/panel_wide.csv period column reads as int64 (200410..202608); periods are 6-char YYYYMM strings semantically and are reported as strings here.

No number in this file was estimated, interpolated, or taken from an external paper. Files consulted but yielding nothing usable: stage0/results/_all_web_tables.json was not needed (direct CSVs were authoritative).
